SyncedBookmark.title: SyncedBookmark
SyncedBookmark.description: A browser bookmark synchronized with the signed-in Google account.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this bookmark.

title.description: Display title of the bookmarked web page (1 to 500 characters).

url.description: Full URL of the bookmarked web page (1 to 2048 characters).

createdAtMs.description: Client creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was first synced. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SyncedPassword.title: SyncedPassword
SyncedPassword.description: A saved browser login credential synchronized with the signed-in Google account.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this saved password.

url.description: Origin or login page URL associated with the credential (0 to 2048 characters).

domain.description: Normalized hostname/domain for autofill matching (0 to 255 characters).

username.description: Login username or email address (0 to 320 characters).

title.description: Friendly display title for the credential (1 to 500 characters).

importedFrom.description: Source label for the credential, e.g. Browser, Google Sync, Chrome, CSV, JSON (1 to 100 characters).

createdAtMs.description: Client creation or update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the password entry was first synced. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the password entry was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: User-scoped collection of browser bookmarks synced with the user's Google account.

/users/{userId}/passwords/{passwordId}.description: User-scoped collection of saved browser passwords synced with the user's Google account.
